title: Workflows
description: Visual automations built from triggers, conditions, actions, waits and branches. Drafts are saved, every published version is immutable and runs stay pinned to it.
forbidden: You do not have permission to view workflows. Ask your organization admin for access.
empty: No workflows yet. Create one or import a routing rule.
error.title: Workflows could not be loaded
error.description: Refresh the page and try again.
columns.name: Name
create.title: New workflow
create.description: Starts with a trigger and an end; add more nodes on the canvas.
import.title: Import a routing rule
import.description: The rule's conditions, team, skills and routing settings become a published but disabled workflow snapshot. The original rule is unchanged; decide which one stays enabled.
import.error: Routing rules could not be loaded.
import.done: Rule imported as a disabled workflow.
editor.palette_hint: Click or drag onto the canvas. Connect by dragging from an output to an input.
editor.select_node: Select a node to edit it.
kind_help.trigger: The event that starts the flow. Every workflow has exactly one.
kind_help.condition: Continues on “yes” when the condition matches, otherwise on “no”.
kind_help.branch: Splits the conversation into two paths; “yes” is taken when the condition matches.
kind_help.action: Changes the conversation or starts an external operation.
kind_help.wait: Waits for the given time (1 minute – 30 days). Loops may only connect back from a wait.
kind_help.end: Ends the flow. Every path must reach an end.
trigger_help.conversation_created: Runs when a new conversation is opened.
trigger_help.conversation_updated: Runs when fields such as status, priority or assignee change.
trigger_help.message_received: Runs when a new customer message arrives.
trigger_help.conversation_tag_added: Runs when a tag is added to a conversation.
trigger_help.sla_breached: Runs when the conversation's SLA target is breached.
trigger_help.scheduled: Scans open conversations at the interval you set (minutes).
trigger_help.webhook: An authenticated API call starts the flow with a conversation and event ID.
action_help.assign_user: Assigns the conversation to the chosen agent.
action_help.send_canned_reply: Sends the text you write as a reply to the customer.
action_help.send_template: Fills in the chosen canned reply for the conversation and sends it.
action_help.add_note: Adds a private note for the team.
action_help.notify: Sends a notification to the chosen member.
action_help.call_webhook: Sends an event to a registered webhook endpoint.
action_help.run_ai_procedure: Runs a published procedure; the result stays on the step as a suggestion and is not sent to the customer.
action_help.create_engineering_issue: Opens a request in the connected issue tracker (Jira, Linear, GitHub).
action_help.route: Routes to an available agent by team, skills and strategy; capacity and presence are checked live.
fields.subject: Subject
fields_ui.name: Name
fields_ui.title: Title
wait_help: The run pauses while waiting and resumes within a minute once the time is up.
targets.manual: The list could not be loaded; enter the ID (UUID) manually.
route.vip_account_owner: Assign VIP companies to their account owner
route.help: Settings are fixed when you publish; capacity and presence are checked at run time.
issues.none: No issues; the draft can be saved.
issues.node_count: A workflow needs between {{min}} and {{max}} nodes.
issues.edge_count: You can add at most {{max}} connections.
issues.too_large: The workflow is too large (max 128 KiB). Remove some nodes or shorten texts.
issues.duplicate: Two nodes share the same ID. Delete one and add it again.
issues.trigger_count: A workflow needs exactly one trigger.
issues.trigger_schedule: Enter an interval of 1–525,600 minutes for a scheduled trigger; other triggers don't take one.
issues.condition_shape: Each condition must be a group or a single field comparison.
issues.condition_too_large: Conditions are too complex (max 8 levels, 128 items). Simplify them.
issues.condition_field: Unknown field: {{field}}. Pick a field from the list.
issues.condition_list: Enter comma-separated values for “is one of”.
issues.condition_number: Enter a number for this comparison.
issues.action_target: Choose a target for this action.
issues.action_route: Check the routing settings: pick a strategy and add at most 32 skills.
issues.wait_range: Enter a wait time between 1 minute and 30 days.
issues.dangling_edge: A connection points to a deleted node. Delete the connection.
issues.bad_input: Nothing can connect into a trigger. Delete the connection.
issues.bad_port: This node has no such output. Delete the connection and reconnect it.
issues.loop_not_wait: Loops can only connect back from a wait node.
issues.port_multi: Each output can connect to only one node.
issues.port_open: Unconnected output: {{ports}}. Connect it to a node or an end.
issues.cycle: To make a loop, connect back from a wait node.
issues.unreachable: This node can't be reached from the trigger. Connect it or delete it.
issues.no_end: No end can be reached from this node. Connect its path to an end.
publish.title: Publish draft r{{version}}
publish.description: A published version is immutable; new runs use it while existing runs keep their version.
versions.restored: Version loaded into the draft; save and publish it.
runs.forbidden: You do not have permission to view this run's conversation.
runs.uncertain: This step's outcome is uncertain and it was not retried. Check the result manually.
test.title: Test (dry run)
test.description: The saved draft is evaluated step by step on a sample conversation. Nothing is written; it stops at the first wait.
test.search: Search conversations or paste an ID
test.hypothetical: External outcomes are hypothetical; status, priority, assignment and tag changes are simulated, not saved.
toast.failed: Could not complete the action. Try again.
toast.conflict: The draft changed elsewhere. Refresh the page and try again.
